entries.subject: Size: Herschel and Spitzer thermal diameter (Vilenius et al. 2012)
entries.finding: Goibniu is drawn as a sphere at the 680 +/- 34 km diameter measured from thermal emission by Vilenius et al. (2012), A&A 541, A94, using Herschel PACS and Spitzer MIPS radiometry. No shape model is published, so the sphere is illustrative.
